definitions.explanation: The process of gradual change and development through history.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}の{変遷|へんせん}を{研究|けんきゅう}する。
examples.english: To research the evolution of language.

examples.japanese: {時代|じだい}の{変遷|へんせん}とともに{変|か}わった。
examples.english: It changed with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}の{変遷|へんせん}をたどる。
examples.english: To trace the changes through history.

notes:
{変遷|へんせん} refers to gradual change and evolution over time, typically used when discussing historical or social developments.

WORD FORMATION:
{変|へん} (change) + {遷|せん} (shift/move) = transition over time

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {時代|じだい}の{変遷|へんせん}: changes through the ages
- {歴史|れきし}の{変遷|へんせん}: historical transitions
- {変遷|へんせん}をたどる: to trace changes/evolution
- {言葉|ことば}の{変遷|へんせん}: evolution of language
- {変遷|へんせん}を{経|へ}る: to go through changes

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
- {社会|しゃかい}の{変遷|へんせん}: social changes
- {文化|ぶんか}の{変遷|へんせん}: cultural evolution
- {制度|せいど}の{変遷|へんせん}: institutional changes

REGISTER:
Formal/academic. Common in scholarly writing and historical discussions.
